cwe_descriptions: CWE-20: Improper Input Validation — The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.
CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') — The product contains an iteration or loop with an exit condition that cannot be reached, i.e., an infinite loop.
